System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs 10.0.5 (.NET denial of service) is compiled into the Nutrient Web SDK's WebAssembly bundle (gdpicture-*), which runs only in the viewer's own browser tab; the ops server never executes it. Nutrient 1.23.0, the latest stable, still bundles 10.0.5. Exception accepted by the product owner 2026-10-14 for the High SLA window only; upgrade the SDK when a fixed bundle ships.
